moves.label: Quick Patch Jab
moves.description: Fast high jab with a short active window for close pressure.
moves.reason: Compact standing punch at upper-body height.

moves.label: Low Spike Tap
moves.description: Fast low tap that clips the legs with a tiny quick strike.
moves.reason: Single low frame and low-hit data read as a quick leg poke.

moves.label: Patch Mid Check
moves.description: Quick mid check with a compact arm swing and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Short mid-height punch sequence.

moves.label: Rolling Patch Rush
moves.description: Slow mid rush that rolls forward with weak right-side tracking.
moves.reason: The frames turn Don Patch into a rolling orange ball.

moves.label: Poppa Rocks Pose
moves.description: Slow mid string that transforms into a flashy Poppa Rocks flourish.
moves.reason: The command visibly shifts into a suited pose sequence.

moves.label: Spike Pop Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher from a tiny low spike hit.
moves.reason: Single-frame launcher slot needs a concrete move-list name.

moves.label: Rolling Mid Rush
moves.description: Quick mid rolling rush that tracks to Don Patch's right side.
moves.reason: Shares the rolling ball sequence with weak-right tracking.

moves.label: Low Spike Fakeout
moves.description: Steady low feint that threatens a tiny ground-level spike.
moves.reason: Single low frame and low-hit data read as a fakeout poke.

moves.label: Rolling Trip
moves.description: Slow low knockdown that rolls across the floor into a trip.
moves.reason: Low rolling sequence is authored as a knockdown.

moves.label: Patch Star Crush
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown that bursts into a bright star-shaped hit.
moves.reason: The sequence transforms into a star impact and knockdown.

moves.label: Crouch Spin Roll
moves.description: Fast mid crouch attack that tumbles forward through long active spin frames.
moves.reason: Full-crouch route rolls low through several frames.

moves.label: Crouch Patch Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher from a crouched Poppa Rocks hand strike.
moves.reason: Crouch route is authored as a launcher and uses a lifting hand pose.

moves.label: Charged Patch Jab
moves.description: Fast high charged jab with compact active timing.
moves.reason: Charge command reuses the quick high jab frames.

moves.label: Poppa Rocks Aura
moves.description: Fast special knockdown that powers through a long golden aura rush.
moves.reason: Charge special turns Don Patch golden and is authored as knockdown.

moves.label: Charged Rolling Rush
moves.description: Fast mid charged roll that tracks to the right through a long active rush.
moves.reason: Charge command uses the rolling weak-right sequence.

moves.label: Sidestep Spike Low
moves.description: Fast low sidestep poke that clips with a tiny ground-level spike.
moves.reason: Sidestep low slot is a single low spike frame.

moves.label: Sidestep Rolling Rush
moves.description: Quick mid sidestep roll with weak right-side tracking.
moves.reason: Sidestep command uses the rolling weak-right attack.

moves.label: While-Rising Patch Check
moves.description: Quick mid while-standing check with a short active window.
moves.reason: While-standing route uses the compact mid punch frames.

moves.label: While-Rising Roll
moves.description: Steady mid while-standing roll that tracks to Don Patch's right.
moves.reason: While-standing command uses the right-tracking rolling sequence.

moves.label: Low-Step Patch Jab
moves.description: Fast high poke from a low command that still hits upper body.
moves.reason: The contact frames match the high jab.

moves.label: Down Spike Low
moves.description: Fast low down-command poke with a tiny ground-level hit.
moves.reason: Single low active frame and down command support a low poke name.

moves.label: Diagonal Patch Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher from a compact forward hand strike.
moves.reason: d/f command is authored as launcher.

moves.label: Diagonal Spike Low
moves.description: Fast low diagonal poke that clips from a tiny ground-level hit.
moves.reason: Single low active frame and d/f command.

moves.label: Forward Patch Check
moves.description: Slow mid forward check with a committed step-in strike.
moves.reason: Forward route uses the compact mid punch sequence.

moves.label: Forward Patch Hook
moves.description: Quick mid forward hook with a short active window.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the mid punch frames.

moves.label: Forward Spike Low
moves.description: Fast low forward poke with long active low pressure.
moves.reason: Single-frame low visual and forward low command.

moves.label: Patch Dash Jab
moves.description: Fast high motion jab with compact recovery.
moves.reason: qcf command reuses the high jab contact frames.

moves.label: Spinning Spike Low
moves.description: Fast low motion poke that threatens legs with long active timing.
moves.reason: qcf low route is the same low spike family.

moves.label: Rolling Star Burst
moves.description: Slow mid knockdown that rolls into a heavy right-tracking finish.
moves.reason: qcf finisher uses the rolling knockdown route.
